sentences.japanese: 競技者は気迫と自信に満ちていた。
sentences.english: The athlete was full of spirit and confidence.

sentences.japanese: 管弦楽団は郷愁に満ちた音楽を演奏し始めた。
sentences.english: The orchestra struck up nostalgic music.

sentences.japanese: 角のガソリンスタンドで満タンにしたんだ。
sentences.english: I had my car filled up at the service station at the corner.

sentences.japanese: 潮の満ち干は月の運行に左右される。
sentences.english: The rise and fall of the sea is governed by the moon.

sentences.japanese: 我が家の庭は甘い香りの花で満ちている。
sentences.english: My garden is filled with sweet-smelling blooms.
